subject: Error : Rejecting user-specified initialization because of vanishing density.

messages.author: 89a4640ddc6e46d0
messages.subject: Error : Rejecting user-specified initialization because of vanishing density.
parts:
Hi,

I'm getting the error:

Error : Rejecting user-specified initialization because of vanishing density.

I was hoping for some tips on how to troubleshoot this?

thanks

mark

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Error : Rejecting user-specified initialization because of vanishing density.
parts:
On Monday, November 3, 2014 7:38:35 AM UTC-5, Markian Pahuta wrote:
I'm getting the error:

Error : Rejecting user-specified initialization because of vanishing density.

I was hoping for some tips on how to troubleshoot this?

Start by omitting the user-specified inits. If that doesn't work, try specifying init="0". If that doesn't work, then there is probably a problem with your Stan program. If something does work, then you might be able to play around with the interval for the inits so that it is something smaller than (-2,2).

Ben

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Error : Rejecting user-specified initialization because of vanishing density.
parts:
That means your init's out of support for the specified density.

You have to provide initialization within the support of the
distribution, and not just the theoretical support, but the
numerical support, which can be stricter.

- Bob
